d:
Use this 8-minute Yoga Nidra session to experience deep relaxation when you are short on time and need a quick recharge.
When you are tired and feeling the weight of a busy day, this practice provides a moment to pause. By following these simple instructions, you can quiet your mind and settle your body for a short nap that helps you feel restored.
This session guides you into a gentle state of rest. As you lie down and watch your breath, you will find the stress relief necessary to continue your day with renewed focus and calmness.
